title: Mapped single-complex cycles normalization after shift
statement: Let B,C be abelian categories, C with a chosen derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], G : B → C additive, X : B and n : ℕ. Put S = single_n X, GS = G(S) as bounded-below complexes, H₀ = H^0 on D⁺(C), and let d be inverse single shift on C followed by H₀.shiftIso (-n,n,0). The composite homologyπ(GS,n), homologyFunctorObjQIso(GS,n) inverse, H^n of mapHomotopyCategoryPlusSingleFunctorQhObjIso(n,X) hom, and d at G(X), equals iCycles(GS,n), followed by G(singleObjXSelf(n,X).hom) and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso(0) inverse at G(X). There is no enough-injectives hypothesis or derived category hypothesis on B, and no derived unit.

proof.text: Cancel the degree-zero single homology comparison on the right and use lem-pc-single-homology-shift-comparison to replace d followed by that comparison by the degree-n comparison.

Express the mapped-single derived isomorphism as Q applied to the sole-term cochain isomorphism p : GS → single_n G(X). Expand singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso and homologyFunctorObjQIso: singleFunctorsPostcompQIso_inv_hom and the quotient factorization identities cancel, identifying the degree-n comparison with singleObjHomologySelfIso. Apply homologyFunctorObjQIso_hom_naturality to p, then homologyπ_naturality and homologyπ_singleObjHomologySelfIso_hom. Rewrite singleObjCyclesSelfIso_hom and cyclesMap_i. Finally singleMapHomologicalComplex_hom_app_self identifies p.f n with G(singleObjXSelf.hom) followed by singleObjXSelf inverse; cancel its inverse/hom pair.
